integrity: The all-length statement is proved by an exact two-link Bell contraction and induction. A standard-library checker independently contracts the tensors for heterogeneous finite examples and checks the source-family specialization; those computations corroborate but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the repeated postselected Phi-plus branch for the displayed oriented rank-deficient X-state face is covered.
No characterization of all rank-deficient two-qubit links, no optimization over Bell outcomes, and no adaptive-strategy theorem is claimed.
The successful branch may have exponentially decaying probability; the theorem concerns persistence of positive conditional entanglement rather than deterministic transmission.
title: An exact Bell-swap semigroup on a rank-deficient X-state face
